rule.text: Every segment boundary falls at a sentence boundary; no sentence is cut by the separator.

constraints.note: a segment that ends mid-sentence, which the count cannot see

rule.text: Each segment reads on its own when quoted out of the thread.

constraints.note: a segment that is only a fragment of the previous one

delivery_notes: Posted as numbered segments, each shown alone in a feed and quoted alone. The first segment is the whole piece to most readers. A link in the first segment is what the platform down-ranks and what readers skip.
